title: Ambient Occlusion Baking Preview Tool
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an ambient occlusion (AO) baking preview tool. Load the 3D model 'coffeemat.glb' using GLTFLoader and provide interactive AO controls.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at origin.
- OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- A neutral gray (#404040) background.
- One DirectionalLight at (3, 5, 4) with intensity 1.0 and a soft AmbientLight at intensity 0.3.
- A ground plane (10x10) at y=0 with a subtle grid texture or flat gray material.
- Load 'coffeemat.glb' centered at origin on the ground plane. After loading, normalize the model so its bounding box fits within a 2-unit cube, centered at (0, 1, 0).

AO BAKING SIMULATION:
- Implement a simulated AO baking system. For each mesh in the loaded model, compute a per-vertex AO approximation using raycasting: for each vertex, cast N rays in the hemisphere oriented along the vertex normal and count occlusion hits against the scene geometry.
- Expose a 'sampleCount' parameter (values: 8, 16, 32, 64, 128) controlling how many rays per vertex.
- Store the AO result as a vertex color attribute on each mesh. Blend the AO into the material using a mix factor ('aoIntensity', range 0.0 to 1.0, default 0.5).
- Since real raycasting AO can be slow, implement a simplified version: use THREE.Raycaster, cast rays from each vertex position along randomized hemisphere directions (seeded by vertex index for determinism), test intersection against all scene meshes, and mark occlusion if a hit occurs within a 'aoRadius' distance (range 0.1 to 3.0, default 1.0).
- Track baking progress as a percentage (0-100).

UI CONTROLS (DOM overlay, top-left panel, 280px wide):
- Title: 'AO Baking Preview'
- Dropdown for 'Sample Count': options 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 (default 32).
- Slider for 'AO Intensity': 0.0 to 1.0, step 0.01, default 0.5. Label shows current value.
- Slider for 'AO Radius': 0.1 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0. Label shows current value.
- Button 'Bake AO' that triggers the baking computation. During baking, button text changes to 'Baking... X%' and is disabled.
- Button 'Reset AO' that clears all vertex color AO data and restores original materials.
- Toggle checkbox 'Show AO Only' — when checked, render meshes with only the AO vertex colors (grayscale), ignoring albedo/texture. When unchecked, blend AO with original material.
- A status line showing: 'Status: Ready', 'Status: Baking...', or 'Status: Complete (Nms)' with bake duration in milliseconds.
- Checkbox 'Wireframe Overlay' — toggles wireframe rendering on all model meshes.

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:
- Press 'B' to trigger bake (same as clicking Bake AO button).
- Press 'R' to reset AO.
- Press 'W' to toggle wireframe.
- Press '1'-'5' to set sample count to 8/16/32/64/128 respectively.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- modelLoaded: boolean, true after coffeemat.glb is loaded and normalized.
- meshCount: number of meshes found in the loaded model.
- sampleCount: current sample count (number).
- aoIntensity: current AO intensity (number).
- aoRadius: current AO radius (number).
- isBaking: boolean, true while baking is in progress.
- bakeProgress: number 0-100.
- bakeComplete: boolean, true after at least one successful bake.
- bakeDurationMs: number, milliseconds of last bake, or 0 if never baked.
- aoDataApplied: boolean, true if AO vertex colors are currently applied to meshes.
- showAOOnly: boolean, current state of the AO-only toggle.
- wireframeEnabled: boolean, current wireframe state.
- verticesProcessed: total number of vertices that were processed during last bake.
- cameraDistance: number, current distance from camera to origin.
- groundPlaneVisible: boolean.

All state fields must update in real-time as the user interacts. Bake progress should update incrementally during the baking process (use requestAnimationFrame or setTimeout chunking to avoid blocking the UI).
physics_constraints: AO rays must respect hemisphere orientation (dot product with normal >= 0). AO values per vertex must be clamped to [0, 1]. Bake progress must monotonically increase from 0 to 100 during a bake. aoIntensity and aoRadius must stay within their defined ranges. Camera distance must always be positive and finite.
